title: Organization
description: One organization a Veteran can contact. Contact details here are OFFICE contact details published by the organization itself. No personal contact information for any individual belongs in this repo, because everything in it is published to the open web.

vaAccredited.description: True only when the organization appears on VA's accreditation list. Matters because unaccredited claim agents charging fees are a known predatory pattern.

ein.description: IRS Employer Identification Number, digits only. The one truly stable identifier a nonprofit has: names change, addresses change, EINs do not. Also the key to its Form 990 financial filings.

nteeCode.description: IRS National Taxonomy of Exempt Entities code. W30 is Military and Veterans Organizations, but many Veteran-serving charities file under P (human services) or L (housing), so W30 alone is not a complete filter.

irsSubsection.description: The 501(c) subsection. 3 is a public charity, donations deductible. 4 is a social welfare organization, donations generally NOT deductible. Worth showing, because donors routinely assume every nonprofit is a c3.

hasFilings.description: Whether the IRS holds Form 990 filings for this organization. The single best cheap signal that a registered nonprofit is actually operating rather than a dormant shell.
